items.summary: Replace the manual Leave Date / Period text input with a calendar date picker component that supports both single date selection (one-day leave) and date range selection (multiple days leave). Automatically format the selected dates into a proper leave duration string in the generated application letter.

Add a Reason for Leave dropdown menu with predefined options: Sick Leave, Family Function, Personal Work, Emergency, and Other (Custom Input). When a predefined reason is selected, automatically generate a professional sentence related to that reason in the leave application letter. When 'Other' is selected, display a text input field allowing the user to manually type their custom reason.
Add two new required input fields: School / College Name and Class / Grade. Automatically insert these details into the correct position in the generated leave application letter format.

Implement a Live Preview Panel positioned on the right side of the form that displays the generated leave application letter. Update the preview in real-time as the user fills in or updates any field (Name, Date, Reason, School, Class) without requiring a Generate button click.

Add a Copy to Clipboard button below the generated letter preview that copies the full application text to the user's clipboard. Add a Download as PDF button that downloads the generated leave application as a ready-to-print PDF file.

Ensure the upgraded Leave Application Generator maintains a mobile-responsive design that remains clean, simple, and student-friendly. The live preview panel should adapt appropriately on smaller screens.
